content: W3C guidance requires information beyond color and predictable dismissible, hoverable, persistent hover/focus content. MDN documents beforeinput gaps and non-cancelable IME/autocorrection paths. Tapestry provenance should include visible labels and keyboard detail; initial editor verification should include composition and clipboard behavior. Sources: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/use-of-color.html https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/content-on-hover-or-focus https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/beforeinput_event
